description: This Java source file defines the `ServiceArtifactInfo` class which encapsulates detailed metadata about a Service within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for gathering dependencies such as used entities, called services, associated ECA rules, and provides functionality for exporting this information as an EO model diagram. The class interacts heavily with OFBiz's internal service model, artifact info factory, and auxiliary utility classes to analyze and represent service components, relationships, and triggers.

classes.name: ServiceArtifactInfo
classes.description: Encapsulates comprehensive metadata about a service in OFBiz, including dependencies, related entities, ECA rules, and functionalities to export diagram data and manage relationships for documentation and analysis.

methods.name: populateAll
methods.description: Populates all associated dependencies: used entities, called services, and triggered ECA rules.

methods.name: populateUsedEntities
methods.description: Analyzes the service implementation (Simple or Java) to identify entities used.

methods.name: populateEntitiesFromNameSet
methods.description: Converts entity names to EntityArtifactInfo objects and records references.

methods.name: populateCalledServices
methods.description: Analyzes the service implementation to determine other services it calls.

methods.name: populateServicesFromNameSet
methods.description: Converts service names to ServiceArtifactInfo objects and records references.

methods.name: populateTriggeredServiceEcas
methods.description: Retrieves ECA rules triggered by this service and maintains references.

methods.name: createEoModelMap
methods.description: Constructs a map representation suitable for EO Model diagram exports, detailing attributes, relationships, and related entities.

methods.name: writeServiceCallGraphEoModel
methods.description: Exports the service call graph as EO model diagram files, including entities, relationships, and ECA rules.
